LESSON: HISTORIC BUILT ENVIRONMENTS IN THE COUNTY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.5: Historic Built Environments in the County
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Historic Built Environments in the County, part of Strand 1 in Grade 4 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we care for the historic built environments in our county?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the main historic built environments in the county,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Historic Built Environments in the County in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the importance of the main historic built environments in the county,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Historic Built Environments in the County in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. participate in conservation activities of the historic built environments within the county,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Historic Built Environments in the County in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate historic built environments in the county.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Historic Built Environments in the County in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

A. identify the main historic built environments in the county,

   Historic Built Environments in the County helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. explain the importance of the main historic built environments in the county,

   Historic Built Environments in the County helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. participate in conservation activities of the historic built environments within the county,

   Historic Built Environments in the County helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. appreciate historic built environments in the county.

   Historic Built Environments in the County helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

1. brainstorm and share the main historic built environments in the county,

2. use print or digital resources to identify historic built environments in the county,

4. engage a resource person to discuss the importance of the historic built environment in the county,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm and share the main historic built environments in the county,
2. use print or digital resources to identify historic built environments in the county,
3. visit some of the historic, built environments within the locality (take photographs, audio tape conversations on the environments or take notes),
4. engage a resource person to discuss the importance of the historic built environment in the county,
5. participate in conserving historic built

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Historic Built Environments in the County together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: Learners participate in conserving historic built environments in the locality

(collecting litter, sweeping).

● Self-efficacy: Learners engage resource person to discuss the importance of historic built environments within the

county.

Values:
● Unity: Learners participate in conserving historic built environments in the locality as service learning (collecting

litter, sweeping).

● Responsibility: Learners understands and appreciates the resource person as they discuss the importance of the

historic built environment in the county

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental issues: Learners respect others' views/feelings as they visit some of the historic built environments in the

locality (take photographs, audio tape conversations on the environments or take notes).

Links to other Learning Areas:
Learners use Creative Arts skills to create a picture booklet on the historic built environments.

3. participate in conservation activities of the historic built environments within the county,

Remember the key question: How can we care for the historic built environments in our county?
